input_contract: QOM /machine classic-touch-padN-input-hz, N is the SENS hardware channel index; all default1000000 Hz. Readout count is frequency*measurement_cycles/8000000, saturating at65535. No BOARD_ID branch or per-model nominal input.
timing_contract: Shared measurement and XPD waiting cycles use nominal8MHz QEMU_CLOCK_VIRTUAL. Timer sleep uses selected nominalRTC slow clock. The model consumes SW start pulses and exposes real completion and readonly output registers.
scope: Classic ESP32 software-triggered touch measurement controller. Timer gate is checked on SENS accesses and pending callbacks; an otherwise idle gate enable is only discovered by the next SENS access. No IRQ/wakeup, board-PCB/finger capacitance calibration or physical timing claim.
not_implemented: asynchronous RTC gate notification without a SENS access or pending timer
calibrated capacitance or hardware timing equivalence
